f.title: Appoint a qualified pharmacist as general marketing compliance officer for quality and post-marketing safety management
f.statement: A drug MAH must appoint, as the person responsible for quality management and post-marketing safety management (general marketing compliance officer under Article 17(1) of the Act), a pharmacist (or permitted technician) able to perform those duties properly; for a Type 1 drug marketing licence, the person must have at least 3 years' experience in quality management, post-marketing safety management or similar duties.

rows.actor: Drug marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote:
第八十五条 　 医薬品の製造販売業者は、法第十七条第一項の規定により、医薬品の品質管理及び製造販売後安全管理を行わせるために、薬剤師（同項ただし書各号のいずれかに該当する場合であつて、薬剤師以外の技術者をもつて薬剤師に代えるときにあつては、薬剤師以外の技術者）であつて、次の各号に掲げる要件を満たす者を置かなければならない。 

 一 　 医薬品の品質管理及び製造販売後安全管理に関する業務を適正かつ円滑に遂行しうる能力を有する者であること。 

 二 　 法第十二条第一項に規定する第一種医薬品製造販売業許可を受けた者が医薬品の品質管理及び製造販売後安全管理を行わせる場合にあつては、医薬品の品質管理又は製造販売後安全管理に関する業務その他これに類する業務に三年以上従事した者であること。

A marketing authorisation holder of drugs shall, under Article 17(1) of the Act, appoint, to perform the quality management and post-marketing safety management of drugs, a pharmacist (or, where one of the items of the proviso to that paragraph applies and a technician other than a pharmacist is appointed instead, that technician) who meets the requirements in the following items:
1. A person having the ability to perform duties relating to quality management and post-marketing safety management of drugs properly and smoothly.
2. Where a holder of a Type 1 drug marketing licence under Article 12(1) of the Act has quality management and post-marketing safety management performed, a person who has been engaged for 3 years or more in duties relating to quality management or post-marketing safety management of drugs or other similar duties.

f.title: General marketing compliance officer must act properly, keep written opinions for 5 years and coordinate with QA and safety managers
f.statement: The general marketing compliance officer must be well versed in the law and practice of quality and post-marketing safety management and perform those duties fairly and properly; keep copies of written opinions given to the MAH under Article 17(3) of the Act for 5 years; and ensure close cooperation with the quality assurance manager and the safety management manager (医薬品等安全管理責任者).

２ 　 法第十七条第四項の医薬品等総括製造販売責任者が遵守すべき事項は、次のとおりとする。 

 一 　 品質管理及び製造販売後安全管理に係る業務に関する法令及び実務に精通し、公正かつ適正に当該業務を行うこと。 

 二 　 法第十七条第三項の規定により製造販売業者に対して述べる意見を記載した書面の写しを五年間保存すること。 

 三 　 医薬品、医薬部外品又は化粧品の品質管理に関する業務の責任者（以下「医薬品等品質保証責任者」という。）及び医薬品、医薬部外品又は化粧品の製造販売後安全管理に関する業務の責任者（以下「医薬品等安全管理責任者」という。）との相互の密接な連携を図ること。

1. To be well versed in the laws and regulations and practice relating to duties concerning quality management and post-marketing safety management, and to perform those duties fairly and properly.
2. To retain for 5 years copies of documents stating the opinions given to the marketing authorisation holder under Article 17(3) of the Act.
3. To ensure close mutual cooperation with the person responsible for duties concerning quality management of drugs, quasi-drugs or cosmetics (hereinafter "quality assurance manager") and the person responsible for duties concerning post-marketing safety management of drugs, quasi-drugs or cosmetics (hereinafter "safety management manager").

f.title: Perform post-marketing safety management of marketed products properly
f.statement: The MAH of drugs, quasi-drugs or cosmetics must take care that marketing complies with pharmaceutical laws, and must properly perform quality management and post-marketing safety management of the products it markets.

3. To perform post-marketing safety management of the products to be marketed properly.

1. The following matters: 15 days

f.title: Report an annual line listing of serious trial and foreign cases within 2 months after each year
f.statement: For each test drug, the sponsor must report a line listing etc. of the serious cases reportable under paragraphs 1 and 2 and of expected serious cases (from the trial, foreign clinical studies and foreign marketed use), for each year counted from the date the first clinical trial plan for the test drug was notified etc., within 2 months after the end of each year. Foreign cases are excluded for investigational products other than the test drug. Sponsor-investigators of approved drugs, and cases where a requesting sponsor is already running a trial of the test drug, are exempt.
